description: Scenarios Network for Alaska + Arctic Planning (SNAP) Tools is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by University of Alaska Fairbanks; University of Alaska Fairbanks | International Arctic Research Center. This website hosts a variety of tools to support climate science and data exploration for the state of Alaska and the Arctic. Available tools include:. Coverage: Alaska and the Arctic. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Wildfire. Assets: Aquatic and Marine Resources, Cultural and Community Services, Natural Areas and Wildlife, People, Transportation and Mobility. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
